rules.name: Wheeled
rules.source_description: Approved by the game author in chat.
effects: +5 cm Move when the entire move stays on Open Ground.
Other terrain uses the normal movement penalties.

rules.name: Cybernetic Rebellion alternate-form movement
rules.source_description: Movement-type design approved by the game author in chat.
effects: Cybernetic Rebellion alternate forms may choose Walker, Wheeled, Tracked, Hover, Flyer, or Burrower movement.
Vehicle and animal forms use the movement type appropriate to how they move.
Base Move stays unchanged; there is no blanket vehicle or animal speed bonus. Wheeled gains its +5 cm only when the entire move stays on Open Ground.
